editorial:
Imagine heading out for a quick evening run to clear your head, only to realize someone is watching you from the shadows. That is exactly how your night goes in this tense thriller. You follow a guy who thinks he is just getting some exercise, but he quickly becomes the target of a crazy killer who treats the hunt like a game. The vibe is super creepy because it takes a normal, everyday activity and turns it into a total nightmare. You will feel the panic as the character tries to figure out who is chasing him and why he was picked for this sick game.

The acting is solid and makes the fear feel real, though the plot moves a bit slow in the middle before picking up speed for the big finish. If you love movies that make you want to lock your doors, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: At the end, the jogger discovers the killer is not just a random person, but someone with a twisted plan to hunt humans for sport. After a brutal fight for survival, the jogger manages to fight back and overcome the killer. He finally escapes the woods and survives the night, but he is left scarred by the experience. The movie ends with him safe, though he will likely never go for a jog at night again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cat-and-mouse chase movies.
